findings.title: Missing Security Header: Content-Security-Policy
findings.why_it_matters: Absence of Content-Security-Policy (CSP) allows Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data exfiltration.
findings.suggested_action: Configure Content-Security-Policy header in server reverse proxy or Express Helmet middleware.

findings.title: Missing Security Header: X-Frame-Options
findings.why_it_matters: Missing X-Frame-Options allows clickjacking attacks framing the application in hostile iframes.
findings.suggested_action: Set X-Frame-Options to DENY or SAMEORIGIN.

findings.title: Missing Security Header: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.why_it_matters: Enables MIME sniffing attacks when user-uploaded assets are rendered as HTML/scripts.

findings.title: Missing Security Header: Referrer-Policy
findings.why_it_matters: Referrer leakage can expose session identifiers and confidential query parameters to third parties.

findings.title: Application reachable over HTTP without TLS
findings.why_it_matters: Network traffic is unencrypted, exposing user credentials and data to man-in-the-middle sniffing.
findings.suggested_action: Issue a valid TLS certificate and enforce HTTPS redirect with HSTS.

findings.title: Open TCP/3000 Web Port Exposed
findings.why_it_matters: Direct application port 3000 listening without an upstream reverse proxy or WAF.
findings.suggested_action: Restrict port 3000 to localhost and proxy through Nginx/Cloudflare.

findings.title: Vulnerability in node-forge (CVE-2022-29244)
findings.why_it_matters: OpenSSL verification flaw in node-forge; however, EPSS is 0.3% and reachability is unverified.

findings.title: Vulnerability in sanitize-html (CVE-2020-7662)
findings.why_it_matters: Raw CVSS is 9.8 (Critical), but EPSS is under 0.2% and call graph shows function unused.
